section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1992
title: ACCIDENTAL DEATHS & SUICIDES IN INDIA - 1992 N.C.R.B.- 5 1.1.2 In this decade, rate of ‘Accidental Deaths’ shot up from 17.8 in 1982 to 26.4 in 1992, leading to a compound growth rate of 2.5 per cent per annum. Assuming an exponential growth, it is estimated that in 2000 AD, the number of ‘Accidental Deaths’ would shoot up to 277 thousand. The respective Table & Chart is presented below.
